preconditions.description: The number of movements n is an integer between 1 and 2 billion inclusive.
The final shell position x is an integer between 0 and 2 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the initial shell position derived by reversing the sequence of swaps: odd moves (1st, 3rd, etc.) swap left (0) and middle (1), even moves (2nd, 4th, etc.) swap middle (1) and right (2). The formula accounts for the parity of n modulo 2 and 4 to determine the net effect of swaps.
